_comment: Thresholds derived from 2026-05-20 baseline run of test:coverage (unit-only, deterministic): lines 57.18%, branches 82.50%, functions 75.82%, statements 57.18%. Formula: max(baseline-5, floor) where floors are lines/functions/statements>=60 and branches>=50. Lines and statements sit below the 60% floor because worker.js, fiff.js, and most of viewer.js are not driven by node:test unit tests — they exercise the browser-only render path and the MEG/FIF reader has no node-side test yet. Dropping those metrics to (baseline-5) reflects the testable surface today; re-baseline quarterly and raise by 2-3%.
